predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Hammarby FF vs IFK Goteborg: Expected Goals (xG), Squad Absences & Match Analysis
predictions.coreRecommendation: Hammarby FF are projected to secure a decisive regulation-time victory at 3Arena by exploiting a clear class, fitness, and title-urgency gap over a depleted IFK Goteborg side.

bqc.comment: Hammarby's 69.2% home half-time lead rate supports Win-Win, while Draw-Win covers early compact visiting resistance before second-half acceleration.

spf.comment: Hammarby's 2.17 xG output, five-match winning run, and full attacking availability decisively outclass an injury- and suspension-hit IFK Goteborg.

btts.comment: Hammarby's 53.8% home clean-sheet rate and Goteborg's three-game scoreless streak without Heintz and Larsson favour a single-sided scoring profile.

goals.comment: Personnel-adjusted expectancy pushes scoring density into the 3-to-4 goal range driven by sustained home box pressure.

score.comment: Hammarby's six home wins by 3+ goals and Goteborg's four 3+ goal away losses anchor 3:0, with 3:1 covering a late set-piece consolation.

over_under.comment: A 2.94 seasonal lambda total, Hammarby's 61.5% home Over 2.5 rate, and Goteborg's 1.64 goals conceded per match support three or more goals.

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Title-chasing Hammarby attack meets suspension-hit Goteborg defense

possibilityAssessment: Home Win — Hammarby's intact front line, 69.2% home half-time lead rate, and 76.9% two-goal-plus home win rate dominate a depleted Goteborg spine (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals — Driven by Hammarby's 2.17 xG/game and 61.5% home Over 2.5 rate against a visiting backline missing Bager and Erlingmark (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
